dogecoin.text: Over 5 Billion #dogecoin mined a year, 10,000 doge a minute.  Interested how many new dollars are put in the system per year. I’d be happy if doge could keep up with the mine rate - just need to buy some scrypt miners for profit - I’m to scared to own large amounts of doge
@APompliano Well, to be fair, even dogecoin is predictable, 10,000 a minute, 5 billion a year - predictable doesn’t equate to better - though with bitcoin, yes better.
